source_kind: User-supplied competition-specific rule, P39; attachment corroborates same verbatim text
rule_text: For a forecast or hidden-future gap, use no row from after its `now`: not the rest of that recording, nor later recordings of the same day. Models may be trained on any released row, including rows after a gap’s now; only the inputs used for that gap are limited. Hidden and missing gaps may use the whole released table.

permissions.fitting: Any genuinely released rows, including rows later than a gap cutoff
permissions.forecast_hidden_future_inputs: Only rows no later than own now; no later recording that day

official_scoring_formula: not supplied; project-specific local normalization only
template_interpretation: Trace complete_template coefficients and historical donor basis; do not treat an arbitrary future-derived table as training. P39 candidate uses no T05 template.
